title: kate-core: newline indent and line indent commands
summary: Newline copies the current line indent. A cstyle definition also adds one unit after a brace. Indent and Unindent shift each touched line by one unit. The existing group test still expects a\nb. This packet does not bind keys. It does not add a dependency. Linux CI runs the tests.

lane.reason: The change is pure Rust in kate-core. workspace.rs is large, so the coder needs a large context. No window and no owner review. Linux CI runs the tests. Also run cargo check for aarch64-apple-darwin.

definitions.definition:
pub fn indent_unit(config: &crate::DocumentConfig) -> String

pub fn newline_insertion(buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer, at: kate_text::Offset, config: &crate::DocumentConfig, cstyle: bool) -> String

pub fn indent_lines(buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer, lines: &[u32], config: &crate::DocumentConfig) -> Result<kate_text::Transaction, kate_text::TransactionError>

pub fn unindent_lines(buf: &kate_text::TextBuffer, lines: &[u32], config: &crate::DocumentConfig) -> Result<kate_text::Transaction, kate_text::TransactionError>

fn uses_cstyle(ws: &Workspace, doc: &crate::Document) -> bool

fn newline_cmd(ws: &mut Workspace, view: ViewId) -> Result<(), CommandError>

fn indent_cmd(ws: &mut Workspace, view: ViewId, out: bool) -> Result<(), CommandError>

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add Indent and Unindent. Do not remove a command variant. workspace.rs declares indent.rs with a path attribute. Command::Newline calls newline_cmd. uses_cstyle is true only when the definition indenter is cstyle. newline_insertion inserts a newline, then the leading spaces and tabs of the caret line. When cstyle is true and that line without trailing spaces ends in { or ( or [, it appends indent_unit. indent_unit is indent_width spaces, or one tab when indent_with_spaces is false. A width of 0 means 1. Indent and Unindent use one edit per touched line. A touched line is each line from a selection minimum to its maximum. An empty transaction does not record history. Newline uses EditKind::Typing. Indent and Unindent use EditKind::Indent. Do not reformat workspace.rs. Do not change the assertion in one_undo_reverts_a_group. Do not edit fanout.rs. A new Rust file starts with the LGPL-2.1-or-later SPDX header.

regression_tests.name: indent::tests::plain_newline_copies_the_indent
regression_tests.asserts: A caret at the end of four spaces, foo, and a brace, with cstyle false, inserts a newline and those four spaces. It does not add another unit.

regression_tests.name: indent::tests::cstyle_newline_adds_one_unit_after_a_brace
regression_tests.asserts: The same line with cstyle true inserts a newline, four spaces, and one more unit of four spaces. A line that does not end in a brace only copies the indent.

regression_tests.name: workspace::tests::indent_command_indents_the_line
regression_tests.asserts: Indent on ab with the default config yields four spaces then ab. The caret moves by those four spaces. Unindent restores ab. one_undo_reverts_a_group still expects a\nb.
